capabilities.title: Physical K/V Tensor Slab Pool Bound to Block Tables
theory: 代码-code/从零构建Astra与Codex级系统/教程-lessons/16-物理KV块分配器与前缀共享-kv-block-allocator.md

capabilities.title: Physical Prefix Cache / Longest-prefix Compute and Block Reuse
theory: 代码-code/从零构建Astra与Codex级系统/教程-lessons/17-物理前缀缓存与计算复用-physical-prefix-cache.md
evidence: Fast CPU Capstone run 179 completed successfully: 136 passed, 14 skipped, 1 warning; Ruff passed

Exact prompt hits reuse logits with zero additional model forward; partial longest-prefix reuse computes only the unmatched suffix and matches full forward logits; full blocks share physical ids while partial tails are private; decode after shared partial tail triggers COW without mutating the source; releasing the source preserves the child cache

capabilities.title: Page-aware Mixed-length Decode over Physical K/V Blocks
theory: 代码-code/从零构建Astra与Codex级系统/教程-lessons/18-PageAwareAttention与异长Decode-page-aware-decode.md
evidence: Fast CPU Capstone run 184 completed successfully: 140 passed, 14 skipped, 1 warning; Ruff passed

Mixed cached lengths are decoded through one batch API while historical K/V is read directly from physical block tables; tests forbid pool.materialize during decode and still match full-recomputation logits; per-layer stored K/V also matches full use_cache; shared partial-prefix state preserves the parent via copy-on-write
